id: \rIf you win, I'll give you an Arceus card!
en: \rIf you win, I'll give you an Arceus card!
it: \rSe vinci, ti darò una carta di Arceus!

id: Mr. Game: \bShow me how you play and make my heart pound with excitement!
en: Mr. Game: \bShow me how you play and make my heart pound with excitement!
it: Mr. Game: \bMostrami come giochi e fammi battere il cuore per l'emozione!

id: \rI'm here to explain the rules of Triple Triad.
en: \rI'm here to explain the rules of Triple Triad.
it: \rSono qui per spiegarti le regole del Triple Triad.

id: \rWhich topic do you want to learn about?
en: \rWhich topic do you want to learn about?
it: \rQuale argomento vuoi approfondire?

id: \rTriple Triad is a game played with special square cards placed on a 3x3 board.
en: \rTriple Triad is a game played with special square cards placed on a 3x3 board.
it: \rIl Triple Triad è un gioco con speciali carte quadrate da disporre su una griglia 3x3.

id: \rEach card has 4 numbers on it, one per side. These numbers are so-called stats.
en: \rEach card has 4 numbers on it, one per side.  These numbers are so-called stats.
it: \rOgni carta ha 4 numeri, uno per lato.  Questi numeri sono le cosiddette statistiche.

id: \rPlayers take turns placing cards on the board. As they do so, they try to capture and gain control of their opponent's cards.
en: \rPlayers take turns placing cards on the board.  As they do so, they try to capture and gain control of their opponent's cards.
it: \rI giocatori, a turno, piazzano le carte sulla griglia.  Così facendo, cercano di catturare e prendere il controllo delle carte avversarie.

id: \rThat's where the numbers come in. If a player places a card with a higher number next to a card with a lower number, the player captures that card.
en: \rThat's where the numbers come in.  If a player places a card with a higher number next to a card with a lower number, the player captures that card.
it: \rEcco a cosa servono i numeri.  Se un giocatore piazza una carta con un numero più alto accanto a una carta con un numero più basso, cattura quella carta.

id: \rThus, the goal of the game is to gain control of more cards than the other player by the end of the game.
en: \rThus, the goal of the game is to gain control of more cards than the other player by the end of the game.
it: \rQuindi, lo scopo del gioco è controllare più carte dell'avversario alla fine della partita.

id: \rThere are a number of optional game rules you can apply to individual games.
en: \rThere are a number of optional game rules you can apply to individual games.
it: \rCi sono diverse regole opzionali che puoi applicare alle singole partite.

id: \rThey can affect card stats, how cards capture each other, the scoring and the prizes.
en: \rThey can affect card stats, how cards capture each other, the scoring and the prizes.
it: \rPossono influire sulle statistiche delle carte, sul modo in cui si catturano, sul punteggio e sui premi.

id: \rWhen you win a game, you will recive 1 random card from your opponent from their Deck.
en: \rWhen you win a game, you will recive 1 random card from your opponent from their Deck.
it: \rQuando vinci una partita, riceverai 1 carta a caso dal Mazzo del tuo avversario.

id: \rThis also works the other way around: if you lose, you have to give your opponent one of your cards, chosen at random.
en: \rThis also works the other way around: if you lose, you have to give your opponent one of your cards, chosen at random.
it: \rVale anche il contrario: se perdi, dovrai dare al tuo avversario una delle tue carte, scelta a caso.

id: \rYou can change what you win or lose from a game by using an optional game rule.
en: \rYou can change what you win or lose from a game by using an optional game rule.
it: \rPuoi cambiare ciò che vinci o perdi in una partita usando una regola opzionale.
